newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SPH to sell properties for $458 mln gain.
newsitem.headline: SPH to sell properties for $458 mln gain.

text.p: Singapore's largest media group Singapore Press Holdings may sell part of its property portfolio for an extraordinary gain of $457.6 million at current value, the Business Times reported on Wednesday.
The proposed sales are part of a move to rationalise its portfolio, enabling the group to unlock capital appreciation in its existing property investments.
SPH revealed these plans in a circular on Tuesday, in which it also sought shareholders' approval to expand into property investment as a new core business.
This would broaden the group's earnings base as well as enhance its revenue growth, it said.
SPH said that if the sales materialise, the extraordinary gain will result in a 24 percent increase in net tangible asset per share to S$6.92.
In November, an SPH-led consortium bought a shopping complex for S$682.3 million from Japan's Sogo Group.
The deal was SPH's second property purchase in two months, after it bought another shopping complex for S$270.9 million.
SPH said the group would also redevelop selected properties to improve rental yields and investment potential.
